headings.strategy: Modern, warm, and highly readable. Used for dish names and category titles.

body.strategy: Clean sans-serif for descriptions, prices, and tags.

layout_and_spacing.philosophy: Generous Spacing Philosophy with mobile-first dense data capabilities.

public_menu.header: sticky top-0 z-50 bg-[#FAF8F5]/90 backdrop-blur-md pt-4 pb-2 border-b border-[#EAE6DF]
public_menu.cards: flex flex-row gap-4 p-4 rounded-2xl bg-white shadow-sm border border-[#EAE6DF] mb-4

buttons.primary: bg-[#A0522D] text-white hover:bg-[#8A4626] rounded-xl px-6 py-3 font-medium transition-colors
buttons.inverted: bg-[#2F3538] text-white hover:bg-[#1C2022] rounded-xl px-6 py-3 font-medium transition-colors
buttons.outlined: border-2 border-[#A0522D] text-[#A0522D] hover:bg-[#A0522D]/5 rounded-xl px-6 py-3 font-medium transition-colors

tags_chips.base: px-4 py-2 rounded-full text-sm font-medium whitespace-nowrap transition-all

badges.base: px-2.5 py-0.5 rounded-md text-xs font-bold uppercase tracking-wider inline-flex items-center gap-1

search_bar.style: w-full bg-white border border-[#EAE6DF] rounded-xl px-4 py-3 focus-within:ring-2 focus-within:ring-[#A0522D] focus-within:border-transparent flex items-center gap-2 shadow-sm

language_toggle.style: flex rounded-lg overflow-hidden border border-[#EAE6DF] bg-white

testing.rules: All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a 'data-testid' attribute in kebab-case.

instructions_to_main_agent: Build a mobile-first digital menu view for clients and a desktop-friendly dashboard for admins.
Implement the client menu using the #FAF8F5 background. Ensure the header with Search, Language Toggle, and Tag filters is sticky using glassmorphism (backdrop-blur-md).
Filters must operate with zero latency (client-side filtering recommended for instant feedback).
Use 'Outfit' for headings and 'Manrope' for body text. Do NOT use Inter.
Apply the requested primary (#A0522D) and secondary (#205427) colors exclusively as actionable highlights, tags, and status indicators.
Cards for food items should be responsive. On mobile, use a horizontal layout (image left, content right) to save vertical space, or full-width image on top if highlighted.
Integrate translation state for PT/EN/ES affecting UI strings.
For the Admin Dashboard, use Shadcn UI customized to our color palette. Sidebar should be Dark (#2F3538) to contrast with the light content area.
Create dynamic tag creation in the admin panel so managers can define colors/icons for tags like 'Spicy', 'Vegan'.
Add 'data-testid' to all buttons, links, inputs, and toggles for robust automated testing.
